in_sanskrit.name: Subi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Good, Beautiful, Graceful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Subi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Subi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'subha' which means good, beautiful, or auspicious. This name is also associated with the graceful beauty of flowers, particularly the lotus.
